main.gutterToSidebar: none (pane flush with the rail in all three desktop captures)

hover.note: team-all capture: hover/selected band rgb(26,26,27), not --accent rgb(35,35,37)

priorityCell.grid: the 16px [priority] column of the row grid; the trigger is a 16x36 box with no disc and no hover fill
priorityCell.glyphInk: priorityMark.cell.ink at rest -> priorityMark.cell.hoverInk while the row is hovered (the live svg keeps its muted fill attribute, so the paint is a CSS override, not a per-priority swatch)
priorityCell.noPriorityGlyph: live carries an aria-label of "No Priority" and three 3x1.5 r0.5 dashes; the draft draws the lucide ellipsis icon instead
priorityCell.menu: opens left-aligned to the cell (287 vs the cell's 286.8px left edge), top 4.4px under the cell's bottom = the row's bottom edge; see priorityMenu

groupHeader.fillNote: capture band rgb(28,28,27); --sidebar-accent rgb(34,35,37) is the rail item
groupHeader.chevron: 28px hit target at band+4, ink color-mix(--muted-foreground 28%)
groupHeader.plus: 24px hit target at the band end, 8px padding-right

displayOptions.surface: menuMark.bg rgb(33, 33, 34), 0.8px border, 12px radius, menu shadow
displayOptions.valueChip: 100x24, radius 8, rgb(44, 44, 45), text rgb(200, 201, 203), caret 18px inset
displayOptions.segment: 32px track, 28px pill, on rgb(57, 58, 60) / off rgb(44, 44, 45)
displayOptions.propertyChip: 24px pill, on rgb(61, 62, 64) / off rgb(44, 44, 45), 5px gaps
displayOptions.anchor: top 100% + 4px under the trigger, right-aligned to it

issuePanel.row: radius --radius-pill, padding 0 10px 0 6px, 13px/500 --ink-soft, icon 14-16px at +6, text at +28
issuePanel.dock: inside the list container as an <aside> sibling of the scroll area (team-all capture path)

band.shape: one 340px-wide element from the header row +4px down the whole column: rgb(15,15,15) at the top fading to transparent at the column bottom (748px)

boardColumn.headerRow: 318x50; icon 14px; 10px to the label, 8px to the count; ellipsis + plus are 24px targets with a 2px gap
boardColumn.label: --text-heading-sm / 500 / --ink-soft

boardCard.chips: 24px pills, --radius-pill, --board-chip-border hairline, 6px icon-label gap, 4px between chips
boardCard.glyphs: priority 16px (No priority = 3 dashes; High = 3 ascending bars), project cube --status-neutral, label dot 9px, sub-issue ring 16px rgb(43,44,46) + rgb(94,106,210), unassigned avatar 18px --board-avatar-ink

hiddenColumns.where: trailing 350px region inside the board scroller (only visible when scrolled right)
hiddenColumns.content: ▾ Hidden columns header (50px) + collapsed column tabs (38px, fill --list-row-fill)
hiddenColumns.note: widens the board scroll range to 2098px, which the capture scrollbar reflects

filterMenu.box: 261.6x707 at (1168, 92); right edge on the panel edge = 77px right of the Add filter disc
filterMenu.rows: 37px input row (padding 0 12px 0 14px, input 202x36, "F" chip 18x18.8 r4 + 0.8px rgb(41,42,45)), then a 6px-inset list: 19 items of 32px (padding 0 18px 0 14px, icon 16x16, label 13px) + 4 separators of 12px
filterMenu.inks: hover pill 248x32 r8 rgb(49,50,52); submenu marker 6px "▶" rgb(98,99,101); icons paint rgb(156,157,159)

popoverMotion.measuredFrom: live popover frames, CDP 9201 (2026-09-14); 3 runs per direction at 60Hz
popoverMotion.surface: linear.app animates an inline surface div (opacity: 2; transform: scale(1); transform-origin: 100% 0px at rest) for the Display options popover; the Add filter menu runs the same spring on the popper container instead (its transform-origin is 129.2px -3.9px = centre-x, trigger bottom edge)
popoverMotion.submenusDoNotAnimate: measured across all 16 filter submenus: from the first frame after hover the surface is opacity 1 / transform none (no enter animation)

filterSubmenu.measuredFrom: live DOM + crops, CDP 9201 (2026-09-14); all 16 submenus captured
filterSubmenu.placement: opens left; the submenu's right edge sits 2.2px inside the menu's left edge (1171 vs 1168.8); top offsets are per submenu (row top −44 for the six wide ones, −7 for the rest)
filterSubmenu.box: border-box sizes measured per submenu: 229.6 wide for the six with a search row (Status/Assignee/Agent/Agent Session/Creator/Priority), 174.6–216.6 for the compact ones; heights 42–270
filterSubmenu.rows: 37px "Filter…" search row when the list is long; 32px option rows with a 16x14 select box at 14px in (border 0.8px rgb(133,134,137), radius 3px) and the label at 60px; navigation rows (Dates/Relations/Project properties) drop the box and put the label at 38px; 12px item counts at 12px in rgb(98,99,101); hover pill 216x32 r8 inset 6px
filterSubmenu.inks: label rgb(229,230,232); counts/arrow rgb(98,99,101); select box rgb(133,134,137); avatar chip 16px with 9px white initials on var(--board-avatar-user)

priorityMenu.measuredFrom: live https://linear.app/easydevs/team/EAS/all list row priority cell (CDP 9201, 2026-09-14; crop ref/linear.app/popovers/priority-list.png)
priorityMenu.box: 261.6x211 at (287, 178) = 0.8px border + 260 content + 0.8px border; the shared draft surface is 260 border-box (1.6px narrower)
priorityMenu.surface: menuMark.bg, 12px radius, 0.8px menuMark.border hairline, menuMark.shadow, z 600
priorityMenu.searchRow: 36.8px, padding 0 12px 0 14px, input 202x36 padding 10px 0 9px placeholder "Change priority to…", "P" chip 18x18.8 r4 padding 2px border 0.8px menuMark.sep font 400 12px/13.2px
priorityMenu.rows: 6px-inset list of 5 rows of 32px (padding 0 18px 0 14px): icon 16x16 at 14px in, label at 38px 13px/450, trailing 16x16 check before the 12px/500 kbd at 18px in
priorityMenu.inks: label menuMark.text; option icons menuMark.kbd and white when the row is hovered/highlighted/selected (the check follows it); hover/selected pill 248x32 r8 menuMark.hover; kbd menuMark.kbd; the Urgent fill attribute is overridden by the row ink (measurement in chrome.ts priorityMark)
priorityMenu.motion: same inline-surface spring as popoverMotion (transform-origin = cell left edge / cell bottom), resting inline opacity: 2

agentChat.measuredFrom: live linear.app/easydevs/{agent,projects/all,team/EAS/all} footer + floating chat, CDP 9201 (2026-09-14), 1440x900 dark
agentChat.footerRow: 28px control row, 2px gaps, 10px from the window's edges; the live footer strip is 1196x32 at x244 with 4px vertical padding
agentChat.cornerHelp: 24x24 circle at 10px from the left edge, padding 0 2px, 16x16 question-mark glyph in --ink-soft, hover fill rgb(27,28,29) + white ink; opens the measured helpMenu dropdown (popovers/help.png)
agentChat.controls: chat chip (only while a chat with content is minimized) + Agent launcher + Chat history, in that order inside the right cluster
agentChat.chip: 173.2x28 wrapper (27px inner + 1px bottom pad), radius 8 (--radius-sm), padding 0 8px, gap 5px, label 12px/450 truncated with ellipsis (8px right padding), close 16x16 hit box with a 12x12 glyph pinned at top 14 / right 4 (absolute, so it overlaps the label's tail); minimized = transparent fill + --muted-foreground label, hover = rgb(24,24,26) + --foreground, open = --accent fill + --foreground
agentChat.launcher: 77.5x28, radius 8 (not a pill), 0.8px transparent border, padding 0 12px 0 10px, 6px gap, 14x14 measured plane glyph, 12px/500 --muted-foreground; hover fill rgb(24,24,26) + --foreground
agentChat.history: 28x28, radius 8, 0.8px transparent border, padding 0 2px, 16x16 measured circular-arrow glyph in --ink-soft; hover fill rgb(27,28,29) + --foreground
agentChat.transition: border 0.15s, background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s (live footer controls)
agentChat.states: measured: a minimized chat with content keeps its chip; `Close chat` (and the chip's own `Close` ✕) removes the chip entirely; opening from the launcher when no chat exists shows the panel with the title `New chat` and no chip
agentChat.panel: 400x600 floating surface at 32px right / 34px bottom; --secondary body rgb(26,26,27), 0.8px --accent rim (measured rgb(35,36,38) — the chip's active fill tone), 0.8px --background inner ring (rgb(9,9,10)), radius 12/12/16/16, menuMark.shadow
agentChat.panelHeader: 48px, padding 0 6px 0 10px, title 13px/500 --foreground at +6px then a 28px round ellipsis disc; right cluster = minimize / open full page / close, 28px round discs with 14px glyphs in --ink-soft, 2px gaps
agentChat.panelBody: padding 24px 16px 32px; centered 12px/500 rgb(92,93,95) timestamp; user turn = right-aligned --accent bubble (radius 8, padding 8px 12px, 13px/450 --accent-foreground) with a 24px copy/edit action row under it (lucide pencil stands in for the live filled pencil, same substitution policy as the priority glyph); agent turn = plain 13px/450 --accent-foreground text with a thumbs-up / thumbs-down / copy action row
agentChat.composer: filled box inset 9px (--accent, radius 7, padding 6px 4px, --panel-shadow); editor 15px/450 --accent-foreground with the `Reply…` placeholder (re-measured 2026-09-20 on /easydevs/agent: 15px/450 with a 1.6 line-height = 24px, placeholder ink rgb(92,93,95) = lch(39.452% 1.425 272) over the --accent fill); bottom row = Skills (75x24 pill, 12px/500 rgb(156,157,160), 14px box glyph + chevron) and attach (24x24 circle) + send (24x24 circle, rgb(42,43,45))
agentChat.motion: same measured spring as the popovers: 58ms enter (scale 0.98 → 1, opacity → 2) and the 207ms exit via popoverOut; origin 100% 100% (the footer chip's corner)
agentChat.icons: the launcher plane and the Chat history circle-arrow are Linear's own filled glyphs (16x16 viewBox, no stroke) kept verbatim in ref/agent-glyphs.ts; lucide has no equivalent
